description: run js code in a sandbox with `ctx` variable exposed. use to automate repetitive tasks in this conversation.

text.description:
js code to execute. You can not require or import anything, you can only use ctx's methods which are:

- await ctx.read("filename", isBinary) - read contents of a file
- await ctx.write("filename", content) - write content to a file
- const toolResult = await ctx.exec("toolname", { param: 1, param2: 2}) - execute any tool that is available in the context of the conversation. Note that toolResult is always string, if you expect JSON, do JSON.parse(toolResult)
- const exist = await ctx.resolve("filename") - find a file, use it as a check for file existence (!!exists)
- await ctx.file2run({ system: "You are helpful assistant", user: "user request: @data"}, { data: "value of template variable" }) - this will execute an LLM request and return the assistant's answer
